title: Whole Flat Topping and Two Way Ribbed Coffer Slab
description: One complete newly authored fixed architectural two-way ribbed slab bay. A single closed monolithic rectangular material body retains an uninterrupted thin flat topping, continuous orthogonal downstand ribs, deep perimeter bands and twelve genuinely blind bottom-open rectangular coffers. Every pocket has four finite return walls and its own real ceiling below the unbroken top; no through-roof grid holes, black decals, detached ceiling tiles or overlapping separate rods. Four complete corner columns with integral broadened flat ground feet meet four finite corner seats in the underside of the continuous slab. Five whole closed editable meshes, three opaque constant PBR roles, one model zero scenes, native metre-style Z-up and true whole horizontal bounds-centred datum. All coordinates authored afresh, no imported or flattened old vault geometry and no copied grid-roof rods. The existing coffered barrel vault has a semicylindrical shell on two complete long springing walls; this is an open four-column bay with a planar continuous topping and intersecting straight two-direction downstand ribs. The old two-layer pyramid space grid is an entirely open offset rod graph with diagonal pyramidal cells, not a continuous slab with blind underside cavities. These differences change the continuous body, opening topology and support relation, not simply colour or repeated-member count. Four finite opposed column/slab seats with five separated sided witnesses each, four full ground soles and thirty selected air/ceiling/crossway rays are checked. No embedded reinforcement, cast formwork, structural analysis, actual span or load, punching resistance, fire rating, construction sequence, building code, dimensions for manufacture, access or public safety capability. Stylized dry static game architecture only; no brand, named building, people, rigging, animation or interaction.
